name: GoHighLevel
one_liner: GoHighLevel is an all‑in‑one marketing and CRM platform that offers API access via Private Integration Tokens and an official MCP endpoint.
auth_notes: Static bearer tokens (Private Integration Tokens) are generated in the UI and used in the Authorization header.
access_notes: Agency admins can generate Private Integration Tokens from account settings; Sandbox and Trial accounts also have access.

extras.rate_limits: Burst Limit: 25 requests per 10 seconds; Daily Limit: 10,000 requests (Sandbox/Trial accounts)

evidence.snippet: Generate Private Integration tokens from your account settings and manage them with ease.
visit our official API documentation: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/
